cat > /tmp/check.py <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, cv2
img=cv2.imread('demo_rgb.png'); H,W=img.shape[:2]
df=pd.read_csv('/tmp/out_test/demo_metadata.csv',index_col=0)
src=pd.read_csv('demo_metadata.csv',index_col=0)
cnt=np.zeros((H,W),int); vis=img.copy(); vis2=img.copy()
for (i,r),(_,s) in zip(df.iterrows(),src.iterrows()):
    xs=list(map(int,r.coords_x.split(','))); ys=list(map(int,r.coords_y.split(',')))
    pts=np.stack([xs,ys],1).astype(np.int32)
    m=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8); cv2.fillPoly(m,[pts],1)
    n,_=cv2.connectedComponents(m,connectivity=4)
    assert n==2,(i,n)
    assert (min(xs),max(xs),min(ys),max(ys))==(r.xmin,r.xmax,r.ymin,r.ymax)
    cnt+=m
    cv2.polylines(vis,[pts],True,(0,255,0),1)
    sp=np.stack([list(map(int,s.coords_x.split(','))),list(map(int,s.coords_y.split(',')))],1).astype(np.int32)
    cv2.polylines(vis2,[sp],True,(0,0,255) if s.type=='rectangle' else (0,255,0),1)
print('max overlap',cnt.max(),'rows',len(df),len(src),'types',df.type.unique(), 'cols equal', list(df.columns)==list(src.columns))
cv2.imwrite('/tmp/vis.png',np.concatenate([vis2,vis],1))
EOF
